name: Sakurai Mayumi
source:
A full-time housewife.

Mother of Makoto. She has a bright and bubbly personality and believes in positive thinking.

She is very happy to be married to her son, whom she has long wanted.

From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mamatuma.htmll]official site[/url].
